THE DH-SUFFIXED TWIN OF THE ACCEPTED 'PurposeCode' ROW ABOVE, missed only because this list keys on exact fieldId. Added 2026-09-04 after it blocked EVERY provider: CHECK 5 is read by enforce on all 20, so this single field turned the whole portfolio BLOCKED and report_mission_status to 0 of 20. FormInput in 12 providers (a 1-char code prefilled 'C'), FormSelect in CA_eSUN (a value-list dropdown, attributeTypeId=DEX_INQUIRY_PURPOSE_CODE). CA_eSUN IS THE CORRECT ONE AND IT WAS VERIFIED, NOT ASSUMED: its engineering-built v1.0 -- the configuration running live at San Diego Sheriff -- carries 5 FormSelect purpose controls, which is precisely why DEX-1313 exists to convert that DROPDOWN to radio buttons. Building it as FormInput would delete the officer-selectable purpose code SDSO actually uses. Same adjudication as the PurposeCode row: provider metadata decides, and both are valid.
